answer_2.quote: We classify all evaluations into three primary groups... Tool Selection Accuracy (T-Acc), which deems a function calling accurate if the invoked tool's name aligns with the ground truth; Parameter Selection Accuracy (P-Acc), where a function calling is accurate only if all parameters of the invoked tool precisely match those of the ground truth... Irrelevance Detection (IRR) serves as a metric to evaluate performance in this regard.
